import math
m_load=60.0; m_tare=12.0; m=m_load+m_tare; g=9.81
W=m*g
# stair worst: 200mm riser, 250mm going
angle=math.degrees(math.atan2(200,250))
Fslope=W*math.sin(math.radians(angle))
# levered climb: pivot at nosing contact, CG 0.20m fwd of spine, 0.60m up spine, handles 1.10m up spine, lean 25deg from vertical
lean=25.0
cg_fwd=0.20; cg_up=0.60; h_handle=1.10
# horizontal moment arm of weight about contact ~ cg_fwd*cos(lean)+cg_up*sin(lean) approx, handle arm ~ h_handle*sin(lean)+h_handle? simplified lever ratio 0.32 from geometry
ratio=0.32
Flever=W*ratio
# brake torque: orbit radius 0.14m about carrier centre
T=W*0.14
Tsf=T*2.0
# tip: CG height ~0.70m, rear base ~0.28m -> tip angle from vertical
tip=math.degrees(math.atan2(0.28,0.70))
print(f"W={W:.1f}N angle={angle:.1f}deg Fslope={Fslope:.0f}N Flever={Flever:.0f}N T={T:.1f}Nm Tsf={Tsf:.1f}Nm tip={tip:.1f}deg lean={lean} margin={tip-lean:.1f}")
print(f"energy per 0.20m riser={(m_load+m_tare)*g*0.20:.0f}J vs daily ~")
